# Links

> Widgets\, linked\.

Every page below is Markdown. Requests are JSON over HTTP; each operation's page gives its method and URI, its headers, its request and response with an example, its errors and its pagination. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` unless an operation's page says it takes no credential. Send `Crucible-Version: 1` on every request you make. `describe.json` holds the whole reference as data (`crucible.describe/1`).

## Overview

- [Service overview](src/index.md): protocol, authentication, service errors, and the operations of each resource

## Operations

- [CreateWidget](src/operations/API_CreateWidget.md): `POST /widgets`. Makes a Widget\; read it with GetWidget\.
- [GetGadget](src/operations/API_GetGadget.md): `GET /gadgets/{gadgetId}`. Reads a Gadget\.
- [GetWidget](src/operations/API_GetWidget.md): `GET /widgets/{widgetId}`. Reads the Widget that CreateWidget made\, by GetWidget\.widgetId\, and returns it as GetWidget\.widget\.

## Data types

- [Choice](src/shapes/Choice.md): union. One of two things\.
- [Code](src/shapes/Code.md): intEnum. A numbered code\.
- [Color](src/shapes/Color.md): enum. A colour\.
- [CreateWidgetInput](src/shapes/CreateWidgetInput.md): structure.
- [CreateWidgetOutput](src/shapes/CreateWidgetOutput.md): structure.
- [GetGadgetInput](src/shapes/GetGadgetInput.md): structure.
- [GetGadgetOutput](src/shapes/GetGadgetOutput.md): structure.
- [GetWidgetInput](src/shapes/GetWidgetInput.md): structure.
- [GetWidgetOutput](src/shapes/GetWidgetOutput.md): structure.
- [Label](src/shapes/Label.md): string. A short label\.
- [Widget](src/shapes/Widget.md): structure. A widget\; CreateWidget makes one\.
- [WidgetError](src/shapes/WidgetError.md): error, HTTP 404. Raised by GetWidget when GetWidget\.widgetId names nothing\.
- [Widgets](src/shapes/Widgets.md): list. Several widgets\.
- [WidgetsByName](src/shapes/WidgetsByName.md): map. Widgets by name\.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): every page above in one file
- [describe.json](describe.json): the whole reference as JSON (`crucible.describe/1`)
- [changes.json](changes.json): the release chain alone (`crucible.changes/1`)
